title: Sleeping in a bed skips time
player_outcome: Interacting with a bed sets your spawn and lets you lie down; while you sleep (and nothing threatens you) night passes five times faster. Moving wakes you.
design: Verified: TileInteraction.Sleep only sets the spawn point (ObjectInteraction.cs:73-75).
ObjectInteraction Sleep: first use sets spawn (as now) and starts sleeping (new InteractOutcome.Slept); a second use wakes.
GameWorld.Tick: if every alive player sleeps, no boss is alive, no kill-goal event is active and no hostile NPC is within 15 m, advance the clock 4 extra ticks per tick (SleepTimeScale = 5).
Game: PlayerController locks the body onto the bed top while sleeping and wakes on movement, jump or use input, or when hurt.
PlayerAvatar plays the 'sleep' locomotion state (from P3-03). A soft snore loop (P3-27) and occasional 'Z' EffectKit puffs.
files_modify: src/Strata.Core/Gameplay/Combat/Vitals.cs (or the PlayerHurt handler) — hurt wakes
game/Player/PlayerController.cs — bed lock / wake on input
tests: SleepTests: after 600 ticks asleep, the clock advanced ≥ 2900 ticks; with a boss alive or a zombie within 10 m it advanced exactly 600
verification: Screenshot of the player lying in bed
risks: Bed object id and footprint for the lying pose; find the bed's top via object bounds.
MusicDirector/EnvironmentController must tolerate faster clock steps (they already do with 'time speed').
